cards.b: All the characters and symbols a computer can recognise, each with its own binary code.
A character set using 7 bits per character (128 characters). Extended ASCII uses 8 bits (256).
A character set using more bits per character (e.g. 16 or 32) so it can represent every language, symbols and emojis.
ASCII has too few characters for languages such as Chinese, Arabic or Hindi. The first 128 Unicode characters match ASCII.
The number of samples of a sound wave taken each second, measured in hertz (Hz).
The number of bits used to store each sound sample (bit depth).
Sample rate × sample resolution × length in seconds, giving bits. Divide by 8 for bytes.
A pixel is the smallest element of an image. Resolution is the number of pixels, as width × height.
The number of bits used for each pixel's colour. n bits give 2ⁿ colours.
Width × height × colour depth, giving bits. Divide by 8 for bytes.
Data about the file, such as width, height and colour depth, needed to rebuild the image.
1 KiB = 1024 bytes; 1 MiB = 1024 KiB; 1 GiB = 1024 MiB; 1 TiB = 1024 GiB; 1 PiB = 1024 TiB.
File made smaller with no data lost; the original can be rebuilt exactly. Used for text and program files.
Some data is permanently removed, giving a bigger reduction but lower quality. Used for JPEG, MP3 and MP4.
A lossless method that replaces a run of repeated data with one value and a count, e.g. AAAB becomes 3A 1B.

gaps.s: ASCII uses ___ bits for each character.
A colour depth of 8 bits allows ___ different colours.
Run-length encoding is a ___ compression method because no data is lost.
The number of sound samples taken per second is called the sample ___.
Data about an image, such as its width and height, is called ___.
The first 128 Unicode characters are the same as ___.

short.q: A sound is recorded for 20 seconds with a sample rate of 44,100 Hz and a sample resolution of 16 bits. Calculate the file size in KiB.
An image is 800 pixels wide and 600 pixels high with a colour depth of 24 bits. Calculate the file size in bytes.
Explain why Unicode is used instead of ASCII for a website with text in several languages.
short.model: ASCII has only 128 characters so it cannot represent languages such as Chinese or Arabic. Unicode uses more bits per character and has over 140,000 characters.
points: Unicode has many more characters / uses more bits per character

short.q: Describe two ways a sound file can be compressed using lossy compression.
short.model: Reduce the sample rate and/or the sample resolution, and remove sounds humans cannot easily hear. This permanently loses data but makes the file smaller.
points: reduce sample rate or sample resolution
remove sounds that cannot easily be heard / data permanently lost

short.q: Show the run-length encoding of XXXXXXYYZZZZZZZZ and say whether it is lossy or lossless.
short.model: 6X 2Y 8Z. It is lossless because the original can be rebuilt exactly.
